about: I'm a Software Engineer at Daimler Truck Innovation Center India (DTICI) in Bengaluru. After starting out as a trainee focused on analytics and Power BI reporting, I transitioned into software engineering—maintaining Databricks ETL pipelines for ~70,000 connected trucks, replacing legacy BI reports with custom FastAPI and React internal apps, and verifying scheduled Over-The-Air (OTA) data scripts on test rigs.

Outside work, I volunteer as the developer for Udayan Care NGO. I built the bilingual (English & Hindi) FiT-UC mobile app in Flutter using AI-assisted UI workflows alongside a custom Proxmox LXC backend running NocoDB and an auth server at udayan.diivvansh.com. After Google Play testing with Care Leavers on the ground, the app is live with 20–30 monthly active users.

At home, I run and tinker with Linux infrastructure. I started with bare-metal Debian, Kali, and Alpine Linux across spare laptops running Docker Compose, progressed to a 3-node High-Availability Proxmox VE cluster backed up by a 4th laptop running Proxmox Backup Server (PBS), and later consolidated everything onto a single dedicated Proxmox VE 8 server hosting production containers and a K3s cluster.

bulletPoints: Maintain and tune Databricks Spark ETL pipelines processing daily telemetry across ~70,000 connected commercial trucks.
Engineered a FastAPI + React/Node.js internal web application hosted inside Databricks to replace legacy Power BI dashboards on multi-million-row tables.
Author and verify scheduled daily Over-The-Air (OTA) fleet data collection scripts on hardware test rigs prior to fleet rollout.
Architected and shipped FiT-UC, an aftercare mobile platform for Care Leavers at Udayan Care NGO, live on Google Play Store (20–30 monthly active users).
Developed the bilingual (English & Hindi) Flutter client using AI-assisted UI iteration paired with a self-hosted NocoDB LXC REST backend and Node.js auth server at udayan.diivvansh.com.
Partnered with the NGO team and field Care Leavers across Google Play closed testing to deliver 3 core modules: skilling lessons, mentor booking, and Red Alert push notifications via Gotify.
Streamlined daily fleet data extraction jobs and reporting pipelines across connected commercial vehicles.
Delivered Power BI dashboards and internal cloud data views before transitioning full-time into software engineering.
Scripted digital verification test workflows in Python to standardize regression checks.
Evaluated SAT solver algorithms for boolean constraint verification and explored hardware acceleration models.
Designed workforce analytics dashboards in Microsoft Power BI and trained Python forecasting models to evaluate workforce trends.
Constructed a voice-interactive smart mirror by integrating a Raspberry Pi with the Alexa SDK, handling hardware setup, coding, and testing.
Configured survey analytics dashboards in Apache Superset and executed data migration across SQL databases, Kobo Toolbox, Glide Apps, Google Sheets, and AppSheet.

learnings: Managed Linux networking, firewalling, systemd services, and persistent volume permissions manually.

Mastered Linux bridges (vmbr0), thin storage provisioning, and LXC vs KVM workload trade-offs.
